text:
mira: quick sync for Solaris Health onboarding tomorrow. need final SLO bullets and a worked credit example for procurement. renewal risk: low but procurement asked for math up front.

jared: can we scope SLOs to interactive routes only? Hosted perf varies by prompt length.

sam: agree. pilot numbers: p50 55ms, p90 320ms during a routing misconfig window, uptime 99.96% last 30d.

mira: proposed onboarding SLOs: uptime >= 99.95% monthly; p90 (interactive <=750 tokens) <= 300ms; p99 <= 900ms. weekly digest + monthly SLA PDF. credits: pro-rata for single-month breach; repeated breaches -> renewal review.

evan: eng note: fallback to a smaller model for 3 minutes when p90 > SLO reduces credit exposure. we'll add that.

jared: credit example for procurement: invoice $12,000. target 99.95% -> observed 99.85% (0.10% short) -> simplified credit = invoice * downtime_ratio = $12,000 * 0.001 = $12. apply min credit threshold 5min and SLA weighting per playbook. i'll paste canonical formula into the doc.

ana: i'll add a pre-call survey question: "Are SLA expectations clear?" yes/no + comments.

mira: action items: jared add formal formula; sam add fallback and runbook links; evan confirm scoping text; ana send invite + digest template. i'll send draft SLOs to Solaris after staging review. :thumbsup:
